topic: Returning an Item Without a Receipt

script.title: NO RECEIPT, NO PROBLEM
script.story_hook: A lost receipt nearly ruins a simple return.
script.intro_zh: 一張弄丟的收據，差點讓退貨泡湯。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back! Today we return a gift at a busy store. Listen for polite retry phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來！今天我們在熱鬧的商店退貨。留意有禮貌的追問說法。
script.outro: Returns don't need to be scary. Ask, smile, solve. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 退貨一點不可怕。問一聲、笑一笑、就解決了。下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Listen once more and repeat every sentence out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 再聽一遍，每句都大聲跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length chestnut hair in a loose ponytail, a cream trench coat over a gray sweater, slim build, small round earrings
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged Black man with close-cropped hair and a neat salt-and-pepper beard, a navy store vest over a white oxford shirt, stocky build, thin glasses

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to return this speaker.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə rɪˈtɜɹn ðɪs ˈspiːkɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想退回這個喇叭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Do you have the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ θɪŋ du jə hæv ðə ˈɹɪsɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 好啊。收據帶來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I lost it. I'm so sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /əm aɪ lɔst ɪt aɪm soʊ ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 呃……我弄丟了，好抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries. How did you pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜɹiz haʊ dɪdʒə peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心。您是怎麼付的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I used this blue card.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk aɪ juzd ðɪs blu kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 我想我刷的是這張藍卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, we can look that up for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wi kæn lʊk ðæt ʌp fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我們可以幫您查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! It was a birthday gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθæŋk ju ɪt wʊz ə ˈbɜɹθˌdeɪ ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！那是生日禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gifts are tricky. Who was it for?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪfts ɑɹ ˈtɹɪkiz huː wʊz ɪt fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 禮物最難搞了。是送誰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom, but she already has one.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ mɑm bət ʃi ɔlˈɛɾɾi hæz wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 送我媽的，但她已經有一台了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, the exact same model?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ði ɪɡˈzækt seɪm ˈmɑdəl/
dialogue.zh: 啊，是完全同樣的型號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same color and everything. Oops.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈkʌlɚ ənd ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn ʊps/
dialogue.zh: 連顏色都一樣，糟糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, at least it's still sealed, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl æt liːst ɪts stɪl siːld raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 至少它還沒拆封，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the plastic is still on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈplæstɪk ɪz stɪl ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，塑膠膜還沒拆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I see your card now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt kæn aɪ si jɚ kɑɹd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。現在能看一下卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here you go. The number ends in seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju goʊ ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ɛndz ɪn ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 給您，卡號最後是七。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. Let me pull up the register.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks lɛt mi pʊl ʌp ðə ˈɹɛdʒɪstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我調出收銀紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No rush. I know you're busy today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ aɪ noʊ jɚ ˈbizi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不用急，我知道您今天很忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Black Friday is coming, so yes!
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk ˈfɹɑɪˌdeɪ ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ soʊ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 黑色星期五要到了，超忙的！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can tell! The line outside is long.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən tɛl ðə laɪn ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ɪz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 看得出來！外面排好長的隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There we go... found it! October twenty-eighth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ wi goʊ faʊnd ɪt ɑkˈtoʊbɚ ˈtwɛnti ˈeɪtθ/
dialogue.zh: 找到了！十月二十八號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that was last month already?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt wʊz læst mʌnθ ɔlˈɛɾɾi/
dialogue.zh: 咦，已經是上個月買的了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, one speaker, fifty-nine ninety-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp wʌn ˈspiːkɚ ˈfɪfti naɪn ˈnɪnti naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，一台喇叭，五十九塊九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the one. Can you refund it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn kæn ju ɹɪˈfʌnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是這台。可以退錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the tag first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə tæɡ fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 我先看一下吊牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does it say?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ɪt seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm. This says final sale.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðɪs sɛz ˈfaɪnəl seɪl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這張寫著不退不換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Does that mean no return?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ dʌz ðæt min noʊ rɪˈtɜɹn/
dialogue.zh: 糟了，是不能退的意思嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. Let me ask my manager.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuːʒəwəli jɛs lɛt mi æsk maɪ ˈmænɪdʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 通常是的。我來問店長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry for the trouble, really.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi fɚ ðə ˈtɹʌbəl ˈɹɪli/
dialogue.zh: 真的很抱歉造成麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's no trouble. One quick second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts noʊ ˈtɹʌbəl wʌn kwɪk ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 不麻煩，等我一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll wait right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ aɪl weɪt raɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我在這邊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, good news — returns are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɡʊd nuz ɹɪˈtɜɹnz ɑɹ faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好消息，這台可以退。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? What made them change the rule?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli wʌt meɪd ðəm tʃeɪndʒ ðə rul/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？他們怎麼改規則了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Since it's sealed, we can say yes this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪns ɪts siːld wi kæn seɪ jɛs ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 因為還沒拆封，這次可以通融。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's such a relief. Thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts sʌtʃ ə ɹɪˈlif θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 太讓人安心了，謝謝您！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, how would you like the money back?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ wʊdʒə laɪk ðə ˈmʌni bæk/
dialogue.zh: 那您想怎麼拿回錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To my card, if that's possible.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə maɪ kɑɹd ɪf ðæts ˈpɑsəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 如果方便，退到我那張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Actually, without a receipt it's store credit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli wɪˈðaʊt ə ˈɹɪsɪpt ɪts stɔɹ ˈkɹɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 其實沒收據的話，只能給購物金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Store credit? Well, I shop here a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɔɹ ˈkɹɛdɪt wɛl aɪ ʃɑp hɪɹ ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 購物金？嗯，我常來這家店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then that works out nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðæt wɜɹks aʊt ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 那剛好合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One question — do you need my ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkwɛstʃən du ju nid maɪ aɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 請問需要證件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, just the email on file.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑ təˈdeɪ dʒʌst ði ˈiməl ɑn faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 今天不用，留一個信箱即可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's ann bee three at mail dot com.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts æn bi θɹi æt meɪl dɑt kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 是 ann bee three，後面接 mail 點 com。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Sending your credit right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈsɛndɪŋ jɚ ˈkɹɛdɪt raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，馬上把購物金寄給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Does store credit ever expire?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs dʌz stɔɹ ˈkɹɛdɪt ˈɛvɚ ɪkˈspaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。購物金會過期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in ninety days, so don't wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪn ˈnaɪnti deɪz soʊ doʊnt weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會，九十天內有效，別拖太久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. I'll use it soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ aɪl juz ɪt sun/
dialogue.zh: 我記住了，很快就會用掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the way, small electronics are on sale.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ smɔl ɪˌlɛkˈtɹɑnɪks ɑɹ ɑn seɪl/
dialogue.zh: 對了，小家電正在特價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh? How big is the discount?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ haʊ bɪɡ ɪz ðə ˈdɪskaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 哦？折扣有多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty percent off through Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti pɚˈsɛnt ɑf θɹu ˈsʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 到週日都打八折。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I'll finally get those headphones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi aɪl ˈfaɪnəli ɡɛt ðoʊz ˈhɛdˌfoʊnz/
dialogue.zh: 也許我終於能買那副耳機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aisle five, right beside the entrance.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl faɪv raɪt bɪˈsaɪd ði ˈɛnˌtɹəns/
dialogue.zh: 在五號走道，就在入口旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing. Is my credit ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ ɪz maɪ ˈkɹɛdɪt ˈɛɾɾi/
dialogue.zh: 太巧了，我的購物金好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your inbox — it just landed.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk jɚ ˈɪnˌbɑks ɪt dʒʌst ˈlændɪd/
dialogue.zh: 看一下信箱，應該已經到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it already! You're fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ɔlˈɛɾɾi jʊɹ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 收到了！您動作真快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just read the number at checkout.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ɹɪd ðə ˈnʌmbɚ æt ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 結帳時唸出那組號碼就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Thanks for all your help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi ɪˈnʌf θæŋks fɔɹ ɔl jɚ hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 不難。非常感謝您的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure. Anything else today?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒɚ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。今天還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, that's everything. Have a good one!
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæts ˈɛvɹiˌθɪŋ hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 沒了，祝您今天過得愉快！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy the sale — happy shopping!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə seɪl ˈhæpi ˈʃɑpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好好享受特價，買得愉快！

script.youtube_title: 【沒收據退貨】「這張寫著不退不換？」完整退貨對話｜🎧60句沉浸式聽力｜購物金怎麼拿、折扣怎麼問｜A2初級｜不用背多聽就會用｜Returning Items
script.youtube_title_en: "This Says Final Sale" — Returning an Item Without a Receipt
script.youtube_description:
沒收據能不能退貨？這段「服務台退貨」美式英語聽力一次講清楚！🎧

一位顧客帶著未拆封的喇叭回到服務台，收據卻弄丟了，標籤上還寫著不退不換。她能不能把錢拿回來？你會聽到一整段自然、有禮貌的退貨對話。

這一集重現商場退貨櫃台的真實往來：查收銀紀錄、請店長通融、領店內購物金、順帶問特價。每個句子都不超過十個詞，A2 初級也能聽懂。

你會聽到：
🔸 退貨開場：I'd like to return this speaker.
🔸 沒收據的對策：We can look that up for you.
🔸 標籤風波：This says final sale.
🔸 購物金規則：Actually, without a receipt it's store credit.

🎧 後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習，同一句先聽美國母語語調，再自己開口複製一次，六十句的句型自然長在嘴上。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。退貨、購物金、折扣這些說法聽熟了，出國購物就不會卡住。

看完記得按讚、訂閱，並打開小鈴鐺，每週新增一段生活情境聽力。留言告訴我們：你退貨時遇過什麼狀況？

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
Can you return something without a receipt? This A2-level American English listening practice shows you exactly how the counter conversation goes. A customer brings back a sealed speaker box, the tag reads final sale, and the receipt is long gone. Listen as clerk and customer check the register record, ask the manager to say yes, and turn the refund into store credit. Every line is short, natural and packed with polite retry phrases you can use on your next shopping trip. The back half of the video is a sentence-by-sentence listen-and-repeat workout, so the phrases stick without memorizing. Great for ESL learners who want real store English: returns, refunds, store credit and sale small talk. Like and subscribe for a new immersion dialogue every week, and tell us in the comments: what is the trickiest thing you have ever tried to return?

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧退貨英文｜沒收據退貨・店內購物金・不退不換標籤｜聽完就能說｜🌱A2初級英文｜💡不用背多聽就會用
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
收據弄丟了，還能退貨嗎？標籤寫著不退不換該怎麼辦？購物金不會用又該問誰？
這一集帶大家走進賣場服務台，看一位顧客如何有禮地退回一台未拆封的喇叭，從查帳、問店長到拿到店內購物金。
你會聽到：
🔸 退貨開場｜「Hi, I'd like to return this speaker.」一開口就把目的講清楚。
🔸 查帳說法｜「We can look that up for you.」沒收據也能用刷卡紀錄查價。
🔸 標籤風波｜「This says final sale.」聽到壞消息時怎麼有禮地追問。
🔸 購物金規則｜「Actually, without a receipt it's store credit.」退錢方式一次搞懂。

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習 🎧 同一句先聽母語語調，再開口複製，把六十句的句子聽熟。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，退貨的信心不知不覺就長出來。

願你下次走出店門時，口袋裡多了一分從容。
script.thumbnail_action: handing a boxed speaker across the counter
